title: The acceptance-evaluation brief has one 64 KiB budget and clips cited evidence oldest-first, so a large per-test inventory cannot reach the evaluator whole, even when cited explicitly
outcome: An evaluator can verify evidence larger than one prompt. For example, explicitly cited records are never clipped silently, but delivered whole or paged on demand, or the requester is refused up front with the measured overflow. The current failure costs a full evaluation round and comes back as insufficient_evidence.
